project_type: Expo React Native monorepo with mobile, web, and server apps
build_system: bun workspaces (bun.lock at root), expo prebuild + gradle for Android APK
test_framework: No automated test framework found in mobile app; web uses bun test
build_command: bun install (from root); then cd apps/tv && bunx expo export --platform android (validates bundling)
test_command: No unit tests for mobile/tv apps. Validate via: bun install succeeds, expo export compiles without errors
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun install from root to verify workspace resolution. 2. Verify apps/tv/package.json has correct dependencies. 3. Verify packages/shared/package.json exists and exports are correct. 4. Verify apps/mobile/package.json uses standard react-native (not tvos). 5. Verify apps/tv uses react-native-tvos. 6. Check no import errors by running: cd apps/tv && bunx expo export --platform android
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access, can install packages from npm. No Docker needed. bun 1.2.14 and Node 22 available.
contribution_requirements: Branch: fix/android-tv-ui-improvements. All TV code goes to apps/tv/. Shared utilities go to packages/shared/. Mobile retains standard react-native without tvos fork.
key_patterns: expo-router file-based routing with (tabs) group. TVFocusable component wraps Pressable for D-pad navigation. useIsTV hook for conditional rendering. Theme exports colors/spacing/borderRadius/typography. i18n via React context with LanguageProvider. API client uses fetchWithCache pattern. withAndroidTV.js plugin patches AndroidManifest.
directory_structure: Root: package.json (workspaces: apps/*). apps/mobile/ = Expo React Native app (currently handles both phone+TV via react-native-tvos). apps/web/ = Next.js web app. apps/server/ = Hono backend. Target: add packages/shared/ for shared code and apps/tv/ for dedicated TV app.
